# SmartBasket — colorful concept app mockups

Three separately exported phone assets derived from the approved colorful editorial render. These are **concept visuals**, not actual app screenshots.

Exported at 1200 × 2400 px using Lanczos resampling from a 1536 × 1024 source render. The file dimensions are retina-sized, but **resampling does not restore true native detail or make small UI text fully sharp**. For premium production use, recreate the UI with HTML/CSS or SVG and use genuine high-resolution food images.

Place the files under `dist/assets/editorial/` and use WebP preferentially. Do not replace the existing live calculator.
